P01.rationale: There are no human portraits or founder images present on this page; it relies entirely on typography and abstract diagrams.

P05.rationale: The three columns labeled 'Schritt' (Step) contain text blocks but do not feature any client portraits or named case study subjects.

P07.rationale: A specific data statistic ('30-50%') is highlighted in a box to serve as social proof of efficiency gains, though it lacks a full press wall or review grid.

P10.rationale: The page features oversized decorative typographic elements, specifically the large '30-50%' figure and the bold section headers acting as visual anchors.

P11.rationale: Real data visualizations are present in the form of a specific percentage claim (30-50%) and a numbered list with percentages (61%), rather than empty frames.

P12.rationale: The layout is dense and magazine-quality, utilizing full columns and distinct sections to fill the sheet without large gaps.

P13.rationale: The background is a flat, solid off-white color with no intentional texture or atmospheric treatment applied.

P14.rationale: There are no full-bleed photos on this page to evaluate for text readability treatments like scrims.

P16.rationale: No device mockups (phones, laptops) or product photography is shown; the content is purely typographic and diagrammatic.

N07.rationale: The imagery consists of generic abstract diagrams and text blocks rather than specific photos of a real business environment.

N08.rationale: There are no large regions of dead whitespace; the content is tightly packed into columns and boxes.

N10.rationale: Text does not sit on busy photos without a scrim because there are no photographs present to create such an issue.
